principles: Presence is checked locally from configured paths only.
A missing source is never replaced with a fabricated file or fallback value.
Optional sources improve validation or features but do not block the baseline.

sources.name: INSAT-3DR TIR
sources.description: TIR brightness-temperature and cloud-top-temperature proxy features.

sources.name: IMDAA
sources.description: Pressure-level atmospheric baseline for thermodynamic and wind-derived predictors.

sources.name: SRTM/NASADEM
sources.description: Elevation and derived terrain features; SRTM or NASADEM is acceptable.

sources.name: CMV
sources.description: Cloud-motion vectors for optional atmospheric-motion enhancement.

sources.name: IMERG
sources.description: Independent precipitation validation or enhancement source.

sources.name: Lightning
sources.description: Authoritative lightning observations for thunderstorm validation.

sources.name: Sentinel-1
sources.description: Radar backscatter for optional flood/inundation validation.

sources.name: Land cover
sources.description: Static land-cover covariates for optional enhancement.

sources.name: Soil moisture
sources.description: Antecedent wetness enhancement or validation source.

sources.name: ERA5
sources.description: Independent reanalysis validation or enhancement source.
